title: Seattle Police Officers Open Fire After Suspect Points Gun at Them
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Seattle, Washington — On December 2, 2025, at about 1:30 p.m., the Seattle Police Department (SPD) received multiple 911 calls about a man waving a gun near 42nd Ave. S. and S. Othello St. Responding officers found a man with a gun and attempted de-escalation tactics including commands to drop his weapon. The man did not comply, pointing a gun at the officers who then they fired their weapons. One officer used a handgun, another used a rifle. According to the Seattle Police, the man was still holding his gun when he was shot, and officers used a 40mm less-lethal round to knock the gun out of his hand before starting CPR. SPD rendered medical aid , but he was pronounced dead at the scene. The identity of the man who was shot has not been released. No officers were injured. A bystander who was in an apartment building was hurt by shattered glass and taken to the hospital with minor injuries.
